# librus-shell (LIBRUS)

> L∙I∙B∙R∙U∙S — Loosely Integrated Book Reading Universal System.
> Multi-flavor study reader: library, multi-pane reading, Hypothesis notes, optional JaaS.

## Product hosts

- librus.app — LIBRUS shelf
- doutrina.org — shared Doutrina shelf
- *.doutrina.org — adhered Centers (opt-in)

## Code repos

- librus-shell — this SPA
- librus-linker — provider link injection
- doutrina-content — editorial source (Kardec MD / QA)
- librus / doutrina — published site hosts (dist only)
- center-* — Center manual + flavor.json

## App surfaces

- [Library](/): Book shelf
- Reader: multi-pane study layout
- [Hypothesis](https://web.hypothes.is/): Annotation provider (external, BYO account)
